title: NodeVerdict
description: The JSON a health-validation run emits: one node-level health verdict aggregating per-check results. This file documents schema_version 1.0; keep it in sync with health.NodeVerdictSchemaVersion.
$comment: Describes NodeVerdict schema_version 1.0 (health.NodeVerdictSchemaVersion). MAJOR bumps on breaking shape changes; MINOR on additive fields/enum values.

schema_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR contract version. Consumers must check this before acting on a verdict; an unrecognised or missing value is untrusted output.

catalog_version.description: Catalog module version that produced this verdict: a release or pseudo-version on stamped builds, or dev/dev+<commit> on unstamped local builds. Overrides and custom checks do not change it.

timestamp.description: When the node verdict was aggregated (RFC 3339).

node_id.description: Opaque identifier for the node under test. Omitted when unset.

trace_id.description: Unique identifier for this run, shared by every check it fired and echoed on each check result. Lets downstream systems distinguish co-fired checks from different runs.

overall_severity.description: Worst severity across all non-skipped checks. The authoritative health signal (the process exit code is only a coarse projection of it).

severity_by_domain.description: Worst severity per hardware domain among non-skipped checks. Keys are category names; may be empty.

affected_components.description: One entry per domain with a non-PASS result. Omitted when all domains pass.

check_results.description: Verdicts for every check that ran (was not skipped). May be null when no check ran.

skipped_checks.description: Verdicts for checks that did not run. Excluded from overall_severity. Omitted when none were skipped.

checkVerdict.description: The outcome of evaluating a single check.

span_id.description: Unique identifier for this check invocation, distinct from every other check in the run.

trace_id.description: The run's trace_id, echoed here so this check result is self-correlating when consumed on its own.

condition_scope.description: How far the condition this check detects reaches: the smallest boundary that must be inspected to explain it. A collection-failure verdict reports NODE, since the rules never ran and nothing beyond this node was observed; a skipped verdict keeps the check's declared value. Independent of recommended_action's remediation_actions, which are always node-local.

skipped.description: True when the check did not run. A separate state from severity, not a severity level.

nvidia_endorsed.description: True when the check definition is NVIDIA-authored.

skip_reason.description: Machine-readable reason the check was skipped. Present only when skipped.

skip_detail.description: Human-readable detail for a skip. Present only when skipped.

messages.description: One entry per matching rule, describing the detected condition.

recommended_action.description: Remediation for this check, including the ordered sequence of remediation steps a remediation engine should attempt. Omitted when none (operational_state none).

affected_entities.description: The specific entities (e.g. GPU UUIDs) this verdict implicates.

observed_values.description: The signal values the rule was evaluated against, keyed by signal name.

thresholds.description: The thresholds the rule resolved to, keyed by threshold name.

resolvedThreshold.description: A threshold value after applying any operator override.

value.description: The effective threshold value used in evaluation (any JSON type — the check's declared Go type).

original_value.description: The catalog default before any override.

overridden.description: True when an operator override replaced the catalog default.

recommendedAction.description: A remediation recommendation. remediation_actions is present only when operational_state is drain.

remediation_actions.description: Ordered sequence of remediation steps to attempt, most-preferred first. An open set of strings, not an enum: a catalog extended with custom checks may recommend its own remediation steps here, so a remediation engine should treat unrecognized values as opaque steps rather than errors.

affectedComponent.description: Summary of one domain with non-PASS results.

severity.description: Graduated health severity. Ordered PASS < INFO < WARNING < CRITICAL; UNKNOWN means the check could not complete.

conditionScope.description: Blast radius of a detected condition. NODE: this node's own hardware explains it. DOMAIN: explaining it requires the NVLink domain shared with peer nodes. CLUSTER: explaining it requires the cluster network fabric beyond the node.

skipReason.description: Machine-readable code for why a check did not run.

thresholdCategory.description: Whether operators may override a threshold.

operationalState.description: What to do with the node.
